Do you prioritize honesty, loyalty, or empathy? Ultimately, the decision to keep the family matter private or share the truth with someone would depend on your careful consideration of these factors and your own personal values. If I had to make a hypothetical choice, I would have likely chosen to respect your relative's trust, at least initially, while also exploring ways to address the concerns you have about the person who deserves to know the truth.
